item.title: History of the first Oscars held at The Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel in 1929
item.description: The very first Academy Awards ceremony on May 16, 1929, took place at the famous Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel.

item.title: Inside Wolfgang Puck's 84‑dish Oscars banquet for Hollywood's biggest stars
item.description: After the awards are handed out, celebrities leave the Dolby Theater and head to the Governors Ball, the Academy's official post-Oscars celebration.

item.title: Cooler conditions have arrived with temperatures dropping into the 40s Friday morning
item.description: Grab the jacket! It's much colder for Thursday with temperatures this morning starting in the upper 40s and only climbing into the upper 60s.

item.title: Opening statements in Fort Bend County Judge KP George's trial focus on $46,500 campaign funds
item.description: Prosecutors in the Fort Bend County Judge KP George trial claim he illegally transferred and hid campaign funds, while the defense argued it was legal, and the trial is nothing but political.

item.title: Olympic gold medalist Alysa Liu honored at Oakland City Hall rally
item.description: Oakland, California, honored its latest hometown hero, gold medalist Alysa Liu, with a large celebration and rally.

item.title: Man jailed after entering Klein ISD elementary school in tactical gear with gun, per court docs
item.description: A man with a gun was able to walk inside a Klein ISD elementary campus through an improperly closed door, according to the school district.

item.title: 'Mormon Wives' tackles secrets, lies and relationship resets in season four
item.description: #MomTok drama reaches new heights in season four of "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives." The entire season is now streaming on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: HAZMAT responds to plant fire in Pasadena, officials say
item.description: According to a message from CAER, flaring has been reported at the facility on the LyondellBasell Bayport Choate site on Thursday night.

item.title: Man charged with murder in connection with case of woman who went missing in 2024, records show
item.description: HPD said Angela Diaz went missing in July 2024, but almost a year later, her body was found in Clear Lake. It's still unclear how she died or how authorities were led to the alleged suspect.

item.title: Harris Co. Judge Lina Hidalgo's quest for video to support rodeo manhandling claim turns up empty
item.description: Hidalgo went to the stadium to review surveillance footage that she hoped would support her claim that she was manhandled by rodeo staff, which rodeo officials strongly deny.
